To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the initiation of PTG triggered by sense transgene (S-PTG) is triggered by an uncapped antisense (asRNA) molecule that is produced from a read-through transcript.
uncapped as-RNA is involved in the initiation of S-PTGS whereas capped as-RNA is not.

uncapped antisense (asRNA) molecules are produced in plants that spontaneously trigger PTGS triggered by transgenes that produce only sense RNA (S-PTG), and that S-PTGS differs from PTGS triggered by asRNA (AS-PTG) in the way AGO1 interacts with the RNA molecules that are targeted by the silencing mechanism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the initiation of S-PTGS by unintended transcription, the role of AGO1 in AS-PTGS and the role of RNA capping in the initiation of AS-PTGS.
the initiation of PTG, a process of major importance for the evolution of plant genomes.
the mechanisms that initiate S-PTGs and how these mechanisms differ from the initiation of AS-PTGS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
S-PTGS is initiated by uncapped asRNA and that AS-PTGS requires capped asRNA.
the RNA silencing machinery has evolved to discriminate between the two different pathways of PTGS, S-PTGS and AS-PTGS.
S-PTGS is triggered by the presence of uncapped asRNA whereas AS-PTGS by the presence of capped asRNA, and that AGO1 is involved in both S-PTGS and AS-PTGS but differently in both processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
uncapped asRNAs are the aberrant transcripts that initiate S-PTG, while the intended asRNAs are capped and are used to initiate AS-PTG.
the initiation of PTG triggered by transgenes is dependent on the production of dsRNA, but the mechanism by which dsRNA is generated is different depending on the transgene orientation.
uncapped asRNAs are involved in S-PTGS and that AGO1 is a key player for this process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PTGS triggered by transgenes involves uncapping of RNA, a process that is not required during AS-PTG.
the initiation of PTiGS is a complex process that differs from AS-PTGS.
the initiation of PTG triggered by sense and antisense transgenes differs, which is likely to have important implications on the evolution of plant genomes and on the design of transgenic crops.
